hero.badge: ENFJ · frontend · one year in Australia on a WHV
headline: Hey, I'm Jessie.
paragraphs: I spent eight years working in frontend development and one year living in Australia on a working holiday visa.
This is where I keep honest notes from that year, the places I have travelled, the things I build, and ordinary life in between.
These are not definitive answers—just the roads I have taken, recorded as truthfully as I can.

persona.p1: The habit of writing things down came largely from coding: when I meet an unfamiliar process, I want to break it into smaller steps and keep a record.
persona.p2: As an ENFJ I love bringing people together, but when I write I would rather include the full context than offer a vague happy ending.
persona.p3: You will find doubts, mistakes, and later updates here. The point is not to look permanently right, but to record what really happened.
persona.aside: Below are notes from my year in Australia, followed by travel, technology, and life. They may not be complete, but every one comes from something I lived or made.
